topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I just found out about it, you know. It’s like the sky deciding to change its spot, and of course, it picks the farthest corner from where it's always been. All these years we’ve laughed and sighed under the same patch of sky, and now it’s like I was never part of the conversation. I keep thinking about the last time we walked in the park, talking about nothing and everything, and how the air felt just right. Now, I’m supposed to get used to misty mornings without him noticing the way I talk about the old oak trees. It’s not fair how the world can uproot someone like that. What do I say now? How do I fill the space that’s suddenly bigger and emptier?
